company.name: Qatar Airways
company.shortDescription: Qatar Airways is Qatar's national airline that offers top comfort, fine cuisine, and cutting-edge in-flight entertainment.
company.description: Qatar Airways is Qatar's national airline.  The airline's cutting-edge on-board product focuses on comfort, great cuisine, the latest in-flight audio and video entertainment, award-winning service, and a current aircraft fleet.

productsAndServices.description: Scheduled international passenger flights connecting Qatar with destinations across the Middle East, Asia-Pacific, Africa, Europe, and the Americas, with Economy, Business, and First Class cabins.

productsAndServices.description: Website and mobile services for searching and booking flights, checking in, managing reservations, selecting seats, purchasing extras, and receiving travel updates.
productsAndServices.name: Online Booking and Trip Management

productsAndServices.description: In-flight service combining cabin accommodations, meals and beverages, digital entertainment, and connectivity options across Qatar Airways’ passenger cabins.
productsAndServices.name: Onboard Travel Experience

productsAndServices.description: A Business Class suite product providing private enclosed seating, configurable spaces for couples or groups, and lie-flat accommodation on selected aircraft and routes.
productsAndServices.name: Qsuite

productsAndServices.description: Qatar Airways’ frequent-flyer programme, offering Avios earning and redemption, tier benefits, award flights, upgrades, and Cash + Avios payment options.
productsAndServices.name: Privilege Club

productsAndServices.description: First Class, Business Class, and membership lounges providing seating, food and beverages, work areas, and pre- or post-flight facilities at Hamad International Airport and selected global airports.

items.description: Old Doha Port and Qatar Airways formed a travel partnership for Qatar Boat Show 2026, with Qatar Airways providing discounted fares for attendees traveling to Doha.

sources.title: Qatar Airways named official travel partner of Qatar Boat Show 2026

items.description: Qatar Airways and Hamad International Airport jointly launched the Fast Pass biometric travel service, indicating an operational collaboration to deploy shared facial recognition infrastructure at the airport for Qatar Airways passengers.

sources.title: Qatar Airways, HIA introduce 'Fast Pass' biometric travel service

items.description: Qatar Airways and Philippine Airlines will deepen their existing codeshare by June 1, 2026, adding QR codes on PAL domestic services and PR codes on Qatar Airways flights from Philippine cities to Doha and onward to over 20 European destinations, while also launching a reciprocal loyalty partnership between Privilege Club and Mabuhay Miles.

sources.title: Qatar Airways, Philippine Airlines strengthen partnership, expand markets

items.description: Qatar's Ministry of Commerce and Industry has coordinated with Qatar Airways in a partnership to facilitate urgent air shipments of essential commodities into the country, already delivering over 300 tonnes with a target of 1,000 tonnes.

sources.title: Qatar well-prepared to ensure steady availability of essential goods: Minister

items.description: Qatar Airways announced a new culinary partnership with Manila’s Michelin-starred Toyo Eatery team led by Chef Jordy and May Navarra to design an exclusive Business Class menu for flights between Manila and Doha.

sources.title: Qatar Airways Partners with Michelin One-Star Filipino Chef Jordy and May Navarra to Launch an Exclusive Business Class Menu

items.description: Qatar Airways announced a commercial aircraft procurement partnership with Boeing and GE Aerospace through a $96 billion deal to acquire up to 210 Boeing 787 Dreamliner and 777X aircraft powered by GE engines.

sources.title: Qatar, US issue joint statement on seventh strategic dialogue

items.description: Qatar Airways has significantly expanded its partnership with SpaceX-owned Starlink, equipping over 100 widebody aircraft with Starlink in-flight connectivity and operating up to 200 daily connected flights.

sources.title: Qatar Airways claims Starlink in-flight connectivity benchmark

items.description: Qatar Airways (via its Privilege Club loyalty program) and QIIB signed an enhanced strategic partnership to introduce a co-branded banking product that offers expanded Avios earning and point conversion benefits for customers; the agreement was signed by Qatar Airways Group CEO Badr Mohammed Al-Meer and QIIB CEO Dr. Abdulbasit Ahmed Al-Shaibei.

sources.title: Qatar Airways Privilege Club, QIIB sign enhanced strategic partnership agreement

items.description: Qatar Airways announced it will be the first-ever Presenting Partner of the Ballon d’Or ceremony, in partnership with France Football, for the 69th edition on September 22, 2025 in Paris.

sources.title: Qatar Airways becomes first-ever Presenting Partner of Ballon d’Or

items.description: Qatar Airways and Accenture have announced a strategic partnership to develop and implement AI-powered solutions in aviation, establishing 'AI Skyways' to drive innovation and operational excellence across the Qatar Airways Group.

sources.title: Qatar Airways and Accenture embark on AI-powered partnership to set new benchmark in aviation excellence

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Debt Financing round raised $1,234,756,587, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 59 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 70 (-6).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Emirates, Etihad Airways, Singapore Airlines.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
